FEAT-5-S142.title: Allowlist Configuration Schema and Registration
FEAT-5-S142.description: Define the allowlist structure mapping tool names to callable handlers and associated Pydantic models, and implement centralized registration within tool_router.

FEAT-5-S143.title: Core Dispatch Logic with Schema Binding
FEAT-5-S143.description: Implement core routing logic that matches tool names from normalized tool_use input to allowlisted handlers and binds validated Pydantic inputs to execution calls.

FEAT-5-S144.title: Unauthorized Tool Rejection and Error Handling
FEAT-5-S144.description: Implement explicit rejection paths for non-allowlisted tools and malformed inputs, returning structured error responses without executing any handler.

FEAT-5-S145.title: Tool Routing Audit Logging Integration
FEAT-5-S145.description: Integrate tool routing events (tool name, validation result, execution status) with debug_logger for traceability and post-run diagnostics.
